summary: Implemented CBTS-935 (Delete a todo): deleteTodoAction Server Action validates the todo id and deletes the row via Prisma (prisma.todo.delete), revalidating the list page; DeleteTodoButton is a new client component using useActionState, with a window.confirm() guard on submit to satisfy the required confirmation-before-delete acceptance criterion. No schema/migration changes -- Todo has no dependents, so this is a plain single-row delete.
